statement.zh: Woolley《乌尔发掘》II（1934）是乌尔皇家墓地（含 PG 系列等）的正式发掘报告（文本+图版）。
statement.en: Woolley’s Ur Excavations II (1934) is the primary Joint Expedition report (text + plates) on the Ur Royal Cemetery, including the PG series as published.
